no-ocean-channel.text: No port/starboard lane markers, road edges, guardrails or literal tunnel walls defining a corridor.

no-infographic-page.text: Do not replace sequential storytelling with a detached textbook plate, labeled technical poster or floating exposition collage.

no-mystical-inversion.text: No magical aura, spiritual navigation, prophecy or intuition presented as a substitute for measured reciprocal-field behavior.

no-crimson-villain-code.text: Do not make present-era Crimson ships secretly sinister, Shard-like or disloyal. Their deep red is institutional and protective in the known story era.

no-green-fleet-ownership.text: Do not recolor Fleet uniforms or Crown ships green to match public corridors. Green signifies the Verge and the life that depends on the network.
